permit_authority.value: City of Henderson Building and Fire Safety Department
permit_authority.notes: Nevada has no statewide residential building code or statewide solar-permitting rule — permitting authority sits entirely with the local city or county building department. Henderson is an incorporated city with its own Building and Fire Safety Department, distinct from unincorporated Clark County.

permit_url.notes: The City publishes a dedicated 'Residential Photovoltaic (Solar)' submittal checklist (linked from its Submittal Checklists page), but the checklist PDF itself was inaccessible this session — it returned HTTP 403 Forbidden via direct fetch, and browser navigation to it triggered a forced file-download prompt rather than rendering the document, on two independent access attempts. This permit_url points to the City's general Building Permits landing page instead; the solar-specific checklist's contents (required documents, fees, inspection steps) could not be independently verified this session.

interconnection_url.notes: Statewide Nevada net-metering framework (PUCN-administered, applies to Nevada Power Company customers) — see the identical notes on the Las Vegas record for why NV Energy's own utility-specific interconnection materials were inaccessible this session.

required_documents.notes: The City's own 'Residential Photovoltaic (Solar)' submittal checklist PDF was blocked this session (see permit_url notes) — its specific document requirements could not be independently verified.

timeline_days.notes: No timeline figure was found on the pages that were actually accessible this session; the City's own solar-specific checklist (which might state one) was blocked.

permit_fees.notes: No City of Henderson fee schedule was located and confirmed this session; third-party aggregator estimates were seen but are not used as evidence per this dataset's sourcing standard.

rebates.notes: No statewide Nevada solar rebate/tax-credit program was found this session (see the identical finding on the Las Vegas record).
